r.지역: Middle East, North Africa, Afghanistan & Pakistan
r.통화: United Arab Emirates dirham · 1 AED = 363 won
r.문화권·종교: Arabic · Sunni Muslim, most residents foreign workers
r.경제 체제: From oil exports to logistics, finance and tourism
r.빅맥지수: $5.17 for a Big Mac, $1.05 less than in the US (Jul 2026, The Economist)
r.생활 물가 수준: 69% of the US level (2025, World Bank, household consumption at purchasing power parity against the market exchange rate)
r.한국이 파는 것: Machinery, computers 24%, Cars 10%, Other electronics, electrical equipment 8%, Tobacco 5% (2025, share of value)
r.한국이 사는 것: Crude oil 62%, Refined petroleum 30%, Aluminum 2%, Copper ore 2% (2025, share of value)
r.정치 구도: A federal system ruled jointly by the emirates' monarchs.

t.why: Oil-rich and the Middle East's hub for finance, logistics and aviation. It established ties with Israel in 2020.
t.rel: A federation of seven emirates. It established ties with Israel in 2020 and, as a finance and logistics hub, practices pragmatic diplomacy, doing business with the United States, China and Russia alike.
t.korea: It is home to Barakah, the first nuclear power plant Korea exported. Korea's Akh unit is deployed there.
t.know: Dubai's Burj Khalifa, the world's tallest building, was built by a Korean construction company.
t.etext: After building wealth on oil, it expanded, with Dubai at the center, into aviation, ports, finance, tourism and property. Taxes are low and foreign workers make up a very large share of the population. Its sovereign wealth funds invest around the world.
